name: biceps-curl-barbell-lying-high-bench
title: Biceps Curl: Barbell (Lying, High Bench)
primer: With this exercise, lie face down to isolate your biceps.
steps: Lie face down on a high bench with your head at one end and your toes pressed against the floor to support you.
Grasp a barbell with palms facing up, about 12 inches apart.
Extending your arms to the floor, curl your arms back towards your head in a slight arc, so your biceps touch your forearms.
Slowly return to the starting position.
